scope: Investigate and tune optional B12X routed-expert integration against qualified native TensorFold; a fresh vLLM 1M control was attempted but produced no valid speed measurements.

method.hardware: Single DGX Spark 61, TP1, sequential trials
method.checkpoint: Existing edp1096/Huihui-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-abliterated-FP4-Local, source weights read-only and unchanged
method.input_identity: Identical workload file; each request checks rendered token count and full token-ID SHA256
method.tg: sum(completion_tokens-1)/sum(backend decode seconds), including reasoning tokens
method.pp: (prompt_tokens-cached_tokens)/backend prefill seconds; report separately. Cold means no prompt/prefix cache hits; the shared OS file cache was not flushed.
method.hybrid: B12X W4A16 routed main experts; native TensorFold shared experts, MTP and other operations. FP32 top-k combine, MMA-packed lossless weight layout, packed route mode and fixed (32,128,32,128) tile / block 8. Prompt cache enabled.
method.vllm_memory_note: No valid new vLLM inference measurements. Startup trials with 0.8/0.75 reservation and 4096/2048 prefill batches crossed the monitored system-memory floor. Later text-only controls used --skip-mm-profiling while keeping vision weights loaded, a 2 GiB floor and a 0.1 second watchdog. Even the startup cache-trim diagnostic crossed the floor at 1.335 GiB MemAvailable and was stopped. This is not proof that 1M vLLM is impossible; worst-case image activation memory was not qualified.
method.vllm: Archived prior recipe in an isolated trial, with the same 1M profile. This is a complete stack comparison; its prefill activation/kernel policy and full-vocabulary MTP differ from TensorFold.

whole_k_change: Opt-in full-K tile scheduling for NVFP4 source/packed layouts with E4M3 K16 scales. It resolved the tested row-position/replay instability, but full-model Medium output equality still fails in two of eight cases; no claim that all numeric issues are fixed.

control_setup_failures.initial_io_uring_policy: The isolated test omitted the archived recipe seccomp=unconfined option; fixed before measuring.
control_setup_failures.initial_generic_environment: Experimental B12X flags initially leaked into the control launch. Caught and excluded; the retained control uses its own archived recipe environment.
control_setup_failures.memory_floor: Multiple controls crossed monitored startup memory floors (initially 4 GiB, later 2 GiB); no new inference measurements were retained.

micro_limitations: Single-layer synthetic timing is diagnostic and is not end-to-end TG.
The initial FP32-toggle matrix and the later fixed-first-row tuning matrix use different random route inputs; do not attribute their timing difference solely to a setting change.
Autotuning candidates must pass repeat and width exactness before adoption.

sources.tested_b12x_provider: The kernel implementation copied from local/qwen38-fp4-local:csf-yarn-20261016 differs from current upstream; actual image and file hashes identify the tested code.

decision.reason: Both tested B12X routed-expert candidates are slower than native TensorFold. Native passes 8/8 cached/MTP output-equality checks, initial hybrid 4/8, whole-K revision 6/8. Whole-K still differs on Medium arithmetic reasoning and prose; arithmetic final answer remains 391.
decision.scope_limit: This rejects the tested MoE bridge candidates, not every possible B12X integration. Dense/GDN operations were not ported. Experimental retained graphs and per-shape scratch caches remain unbounded. No claim of reaching 67 tok/s on the retained Korean workload.

vllm_control.startup_cache_trim_diagnostic: Explicit CUDA synchronization/cache release after each quantized module released about 3.705 GiB at its first callback; a later startup spike still crossed the memory floor. Its root cause is not established.
vllm_control.historical_results: Prior 256K/no-YaRN results are historical and are not a matched new 1M control.
